meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先提问了解你在做什么,再提出一套观察类型和概念标签,经你确认后安装并激活该模式,可选配置 Telegram 提醒,最后重启 worker 并核验启动上下文。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式,或为特定记忆加 Telegram 通知时触发。

say.text: 我想让 claude-mem 专门记录架构决策和客户偏好,帮我建个模式
say.note: 它会先问几个问题,再提方案给你确认

say.text: 给这个模式里的「实验结论」类型加上 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 会问你选哪些类型或概念标签

say.text: 帮我确认新模式已激活,并给出回滚用的备份路径
say.note: 会重启 worker 并检查启动上下文

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude asks about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, installs and activates the mode after your approval, optionally sets up Telegram alerts, then restarts the worker and verifies startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or get Telegram alerts for specific memories.

say_en.text: Help me create a mode that records architecture decisions and client preferences
say_en.note: It asks a few questions, then proposes a taxonomy

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for the Experiment outcome type in my mode
say_en.note: It asks which types or concept tags

say_en.text: Confirm the new mode is active and give me backup paths for rollback
say_en.note: It restarts the worker and checks startup context
